In [[mathematics]], the '''Jacobi group''', introduced by 
{{harvtxt|Eichler|Zagier|1985}},{{r|ez}} is the [[semidirect product]] of the [[symplectic group]] Sp<sub>2''n''</sub>('''R''') and the [[Heisenberg group]] '''R'''<sup>1+2''n''</sup>.{{r|bs}}  The concept is named after [[Carl Gustav Jacob Jacobi]]. [[Automorphic form]]s in the Jacobi group are called [[Jacobi form]]s.{{r|ez}}
